## Summary

What does this PR change? (1-2 sentences)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix — broken code example or incorrect behavior
- [ ] New content — mini project, new example, new phase material
- [ ] Documentation — README, comments, guide improvements
- [ ] Chore — dependency update, config, tooling

## Phase / Files Changed

- Phase: <!-- e.g. Phase 2 -->
- Files: <!-- list key files -->

## How to Test

```bash
# Steps to verify the change works
npx ts-node src/phase-X/your-file.ts

# Or use the interactive runner
npx ts-node run.ts
```

## Checklist

- [ ] Code runs without errors (`npx ts-node <file.ts>`)
- [ ] Type annotations present on all function parameters and return types
- [ ] Comments explain the concept (not just what the line does)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files included
- [ ] Follows existing code style (strict TypeScript, full annotations)
- [ ] PR description is clear and complete

Any context reviewers should know.
